_metadata.description: Privileged tier: bring a node to revision R (fetch source + idempotent vrooli setup); separated from the non-privileged runner.

requirements.title: Privileged Provisioning Tier
requirements.description: A distinct, privileged provisioning path brings a node to a target project revision R (fetch source at R + idempotent `vrooli setup`) and reports the resulting version. Provisioning is structurally separated from the non-privileged job runner so everyday remote execution can never escalate privilege, and re-running provisioning is always safe (idempotent).

validation.notes: Sync-to-revision-R is idempotent; re-running yields the same end state and reports the node's resulting version.

The job runner (internal/exec) cannot invoke provisioning/privileged operations; the two trust tiers share no in-process call path (TestPrivilegeSeparation_NoCrossImport). Idempotent re-provision + rollback-on-failed-setup proven here.
A node at revision A is provisioned to revision B and reports B; a runner job cannot trigger setup.
